what.text: This page follows refugees from Armenia living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4562 Armenian refugees in Germany, 29.3% of all refugees from Armenia.
France hosts the most Armenian refugees, followed by Germany, the United States and Belgium.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Armenia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2005, 2008 to 2012 and 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 4718 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 4893, at the end of 2003.
It fell to a low in 2013 and then rose again.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
